claims.text: Uber's MCP Gateway registers new tools disabled by default, following the principle 'discovery doesn't imply exposure'.
Uber's MCP Gateway requires owner approval of tool-description config diffs.
Uber's Omni MCP exposes four tools (discover_server, discover_tools, get_tool_schema, invoke_tool) to avoid loading the context of hundreds of servers.
Uber's MCP Gateway fronts over 800 MCP servers and 5,000 tools.
Uber's MCP Gateway redacts PII from tool responses.
Uber found that MCP loaded 50K-70K tokens of schema overhead per session.
Uber replaced MCP schema loading with CLI resolution and tool search to reduce token overhead.
Invariant Labs showed that a malicious public GitHub issue could steer an agent using the GitHub MCP server into leaking private repository data.
The Invariant Labs GitHub MCP attack did not require compromising the MCP tools themselves.
A2A (Agent2Agent) joined the Agentic AI Foundation alongside MCP in August 2026.
